title: Belong em Ação — M1: One Single House

scenes.script_line: Craveiral belongs to the Belong family of brands, and Belong's signature is Giving Shape to Meaning. Behind it sits a simple and demanding idea: a place that is well cared for cares for the people in it. That is why we exist. Not to run a hotel with a pretty garden next door. We exist to regenerate this territory through circular economy, and we use hospitality because it is the strongest economic and cultural engine we have to prove it.

scenes.script_line: Circular economy here is not a slogan. It is a chain you can walk in five minutes. The garden gives more than seventy per cent of what the kitchen serves. What the kitchen does not use goes to compost. The compost goes back to the garden. What we cannot grow, we buy in the shortest radius possible — cheeses from the region, fish from this coast, wines from the Alentejo and the Vicentina. And the São Teotónio laundry washes our linen and the village's. Our back of house is itself a service to our neighbours.

scenes.script_line: There is a part of this we say too little, and it is worth saying. Regeneration here has to work as a business, or it is not regeneration — it is charity in disguise. We have commitments to the house owners, to our suppliers, to the team and to this land. Meeting them is not the opposite of purpose. It is the condition for it. That is why waste bothers us so much. Food, water, energy, time, talent or goodwill — we waste nothing, because everything wasted is regeneration we can no longer pay for.

scenes.script_line: You leave with one question, for whenever you are unsure whether something is Craveiral or not. It is this: does this bring the person who eats closer to the person who grows? If it does, it is ours. If it does not, it is not — however profitable it looks. That holds for an investment decision and it holds for how you answer a guest on the boardwalk. In the next modules we go to each unit, one by one, and to the standard each one has to hold. Stay. Belong.
